name: MTP Edge Merida
notes: DCD reported MTP inaugurated the second phase of its edge data center in Merida, Yucatan. MTP says its edge/data center platform provides colocation, security and interconnection solutions; DataCenterMap lists the Merida site at Calle 87, 601 and marks the phase operational on 2025-08-21. Capacity is not stated for this specific site; DCD cites 13 MW across MTP's 60 edge data centers in 19 Mexican cities.

name: KIO MER | 1 Merida
notes: Official KIO page lists KIO MER | 1 in Merida, Yucatan at Calle 19 #444, Ciudad Industrial, with Tier II characteristics, certified operations and carrier-neutral service. KIO spec sheet says it started operations in 2019, has eight ATOM computer rooms totaling 89 m2, six 109 kVA UPS units and two 500 kW emergency generators. Site-specific IT capacity in MW was not provided.

name: KIO Merida 1 (MER1)
notes: DataCenterMap lists KIO Merida 1 at Calle 11, 318, Santa Gertrudis Copo, operational since 2017, with 21 m2 technical floor, modular 60 kW UPS systems and carrier-neutral connectivity. Datacenters.com brochure search result corroborates the Calle 11 #318 MER1 location and 2017 operation, but the brochure page returned 403 when opened; evidence is therefore aggregate/secondary.

name: AiTelecom Data Center
notes: AiTelecom's official page describes mission-critical data center services, carrier-neutral choice, redundancy, 24x7 support, security and backup infrastructure. DataCenterMap lists AiTelecom Data Center at Periferico Norte KM 34.8 Tablaje No. 26535, 97203 Merida, and describes it as located in Chuburna, Yucatan. Capacity not provided.
